name: What should I prepare before discussing window glass replacement for my renovation project?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before discussing window glass replacement for my renovation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before discussing window glass replacement for your renovation project, consider your goals for the overall space, such as improved energy efficiency, noise reduction, or a specific aesthetic. Gather any inspiration photos, note areas with drafts or condensation, and think about how new windows will integrate with other planned changes like new siding or interior finishes. This preparation helps our design-build team understand your vision and propose integrated solutions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before discussing window glass replacement, consider your goals for energy efficiency, noise reduction, and aesthetics, and gather inspiration photos to help our team understand your vision.
